picks.headline: ArmorPaint 1.0 is out after eight years in early access
picks.excerpt: The first 'official' release of the popular open-source 3D texture painting app is ready to download, arriving eight years after it entered early access.
picks.rationale: A real 1.0 milestone for the main open-source alternative to Substance Painter — a tool decision a 3D/product team can act on immediately.

picks.headline: Figma Motion basics: Time-stamped comments
picks.excerpt: A short walkthrough of time-stamped comments in Figma Motion, which tie feedback to specific moments in an animation instead of the whole file.
picks.rationale: First-party Figma Motion workflow feature that changes how animation review feedback is given tomorrow morning.

picks.headline: Auto-syncing Tailwind config from Figma variables on every pull request
picks.excerpt: After a merge conflict broke staging, the author wired Figma variables straight into the Tailwind config so every pull request regenerates design tokens automatically.
picks.rationale: Concrete CI recipe for keeping Figma variables and Tailwind tokens in one source of truth — copyable by any design-system team.

picks.headline: Parker only went and made those viral anti-AI pen billboards real
picks.excerpt: Designer-submitted anti-AI concepts for Parker pens, which went viral online, have been turned into real Times Square advertising.
picks.rationale: A designer's spec concept going from viral post to bought Times Square media — a live case for how brands are now sourcing anti-AI positioning.

picks.headline: Why does AI-generated food look like that?
picks.excerpt: Worms, holes, and cracks reveal the technical weaknesses of image generators - a close read of why AI food imagery keeps failing in the same visual ways.
picks.rationale: Names the repeatable failure modes of image generators so art directors know exactly what to reject and re-prompt for.
